title: A latent dimension of Condorcet's jury theorem for multiple AI advisers
abstract: arXiv:2609.14438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When the same question is asked of multiple AI advisers, as in self-consistency and LLM-as-a-judge panels, Condorcet's jury theorem predicts that adding independent, competent advisers makes the majority more reliable. The theorem, however, has a latent dimension when viewed from the user's vantage: adding advisers also makes disagreement more visible. A binomial model reveals that this ``visible dissent'' becomes nearly inevitable as the number of advisers grows, and that reliability and disagreement both approach certainty but at different convergence rates. The two rates cross at an adviser accuracy of 4/5 (0.8). Below this value, visible dissent approaches certainty faster than reliability and, with enough advisers, becomes more likely than a correct majority. Even ideal panels of independent and competent advisers can be correct in aggregate but appear divided; such disagreement does not by itself indicate aggregation failure. The

translated_title: 康多塞陪审团定理在多AI顾问场景下的一个潜在维度
translated_abstract: 当向多个AI顾问提出同一个问题时（如自我一致性和LLM作为裁判的专家组场景），康多塞陪审团定理预测，添加独立且称职的顾问会使多数意见更加可靠。然而，从用户的视角来看，该定理存在一个潜在维度：添加顾问也会使分歧更加显眼。一个二项式模型揭示，随着顾问数量的增长，这种“可见的异议”几乎不可避免，且可靠性和分歧都趋近于确定性，但两者的收敛速率不同。这两个速率在顾问准确率为4/5（0.8）处交叉。当准确率低于此值时，可见异议比可靠性更快地趋近确定性，并且当顾问数量足够多时，出现可见异议的可能性会超过获得正确多数意见的可能性。即使是由独立且称职的顾问组成的理想专家组，也可能在总体上正确却显得意见分歧；这种分歧本身并不表示聚合失败。
tldr: 本文揭示了康多塞陪审团定理的潜在维度：随着AI顾问数量增加，“可见异议”几乎不可避免，且当顾问准确率低于0.8时，分歧比可靠性收敛更快，因此专家组的表面意见分歧本身并不代表聚合失败。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a latent dimension of Condorcet's jury theorem: as the number of AI advisers grows, "visible dissent" becomes nearly inevitable, and when adviser accuracy falls below 0.8, dissent converges faster than reliability, meaning apparent disagreement within a panel does not by itself indicate aggregation failure.
